title: fix(llm): a non-retryable tool-argument error verifies its own classification
why: The buggy arms carried comments saying the message has 'no numbers on purpose' and 'No byte count here, deliberately', claiming the arm cannot read as a retryable 502. The comment asserts safety while model-supplied text (a tool named 502) still flips the classification.
adaptation: None. The fix's own test, with the test-only SSE helpers copied in.
